subject: Success roadmap: kickoff -> weekly checkpoints -> readout
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Ari Santos <ari@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Success roadmap: kickoff -> weekly checkpoints -> readout

Ari — great conversation today. Below is a concise post-call recap and a proposed schedule for the 4-week POC so we can align on success criteria, owners, and decision gates. Please confirm or flag changes.

High-level objective:
- Prove integration readiness and latency/throughput economics for Veridian’s clinical notes summarization workflow (100k notes / month projected).

Proposed timeline and gates (draft):
- Kickoff: Mon, Apr 11, 2027 (45m) — attendees: Veridian product + infra, Redwood CS + infra + sales
- Week 1 (Apr 11–17): Ingest & schema validation; baseline latency measurements; initial model variant smoke tests
- Week 2 (Apr 18–24): Integration tests with sample dataset; cost modeling and batching experiments
- Week 3 (Apr 25–May 1): Accuracy/QA against gold prompts; regression checks; retrain/templating iteration if needed
- Final readout: Tue, May 4, 2027 (60m) — decision: proceed to pilot / require follow-up scope

Success criteria (draft — please review):
- Functional: 95% of notes processed end-to-end without manual intervention (errors < 5%)
- Quality: F1/ROUGE-ish alignment to your baseline >= 0.88 on the evaluation set (we’ll share scoring harness)
- Performance: Median latency < 350ms per request at expected batching levels; p95 < 800ms
- Cost: Estimated per-1000-note cost within 20% of the target you provided in the call

Owners (suggested):
- Veridian: Ari Santos (product lead), Carlos Mendes (data/infra) — please confirm
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (CS), Karthik Iyer (infra), Sean Gallagher (account lead), Priya Natarajan (trial ops)

Attachments: Veridian_Success_Criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet with suggested metrics) and POC_Execution_Roadmap.pdf (high-level Gantt). I’ll drop a Drive link after this thread.

Next steps: can you confirm attendees for kickoff and whether PO/procurement timing requires adjustments? Also flag any additional success metrics we should include.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Ari Santos <ari@veridianhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Success roadmap: kickoff -> weekly checkpoints -> readout

Thanks Sean — this looks good and captures the discussion. A couple of updates from our side: 

- Please add Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@veridianhealth.com> and Lena Park <lena.park@veridianhealth.com> to the kickoff invite (they own infra & clinical QA).
- Small tweak on success criteria: instead of absolute F1 we want relative improvement vs current template approach >= +10% (we’ll provide baseline stats).
- Procurement note: we need an internal PO to be issued by Mon, May 2 for this POC budget. If any costs fall outside the free trial credit, let me know now so we can expedite approvals.

Kickoff availability: Apr 11 at 10:00am PT works for our team.

See you then — attaching the dataset inventory we discussed.

Attachments: Veridian_Dataset_Inventory.csv

Best,
Ari
VP Product, Veridian Health
ari@veridianhealth.com

Subject: Re: Success roadmap: kickoff -> weekly checkpoints -> readout

Looping in operational details from CS side. Quick notes and commitments from Redwood: 

- Dataset ingestion: we’ll provide an S3-compatible ingest pattern and a small ingestion test harness. Ari — please drop sample files to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cVeridianPOC
- Evaluation harness: Redwood will share the initial scoring script (python) by Apr 9 so Veridian can run locally. Expect Evaluation_Harness_snippet.tar.gz attached to next note.
- Meeting cadence: Weekly check-ins Wednesdays 10:00am PT (30m) beginning Apr 14 — we’ll reserve this slot but confirm if you want a different cadence.
- Instrumentation: Karthik will ship a small tracing patch to record end-to-end latency (annotated to token breakdown).

Action items for Redwood before kickoff:
1) Share ingest docs + sample CLI (Marissa) — by Apr 9
2) Provide evaluation harness + scoring guide (Marissa/Karthik) — by Apr 9
3) Provision test model + API keys scoped to POC (Karthik) — by Apr 10

I’ll attach the updated onboarding checklist to the kickoff invite.

--
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Quick infra confirmation from my side: 

- GPU / model variants: We’ll stand up a dedicated instance with the M-2 equivalent and two quantized variants (q8_0, q4_1) so we can test both quality and cost trade-offs.
- Instrumentation: Karthik -> will push the tracing snippet and a simple Prometheus exporter for token-level timing by Apr 10. Expect Evaluation_Harness_snippet.tar.gz in a follow-up.
- Measurement plan: latency (median/p95), throughput at target batch sizes, and token cost estimates will be computed by combining logs with our cost model. I’ll include a short README describing how we compute token-cost-per-1000-notes.

Note on timeline: I can have the test APIs and keys available by Apr 11 morning; verify that Veridian has sample files in Drive by Apr 9 EOD so we can kick off ingestion tests during week 1.

-Karthik
